title: Caring for and reusing materials
misconception: 1E-M1: thinks materials last forever, so care does not matter
voice: Microsoft Zira Desktop (stand-in until the voice-over artist records)

pages.say: Materials do not last forever if we do not care for them.
Iron left in the rain rusts. A cutlass rusts if it stays wet.
Wood that stays wet can rot, and termites can eat it.
Dry your tools after use, and oil the metal to slow rust.
Paint or varnish on wood keeps water out.
Wash cloth and dry it well, so it does not grow mould.
Caring for materials makes things last longer, and saves money.
Now it is your turn. Say how you would care for a material.
